api.notes: Accessible name and default tooltip; never painted.
Slot an icon, or set the `icon` attribute to a registered icon name.

api.default: md (explicit, then a size provider or group, then md)

form.notes: Inherited from tct-button: type=submit and type=reset take part in the form (submitter semantics).

differences.text: Implemented as a subclass of tct-button that keeps `icon-only` on (writing false or removing the attribute has no effect). It inherits the whole tct-button API, as upstream's IconButtonProps extends ButtonProps minus isIconOnly, children and endContent; `icon-only`, the default slot and the `end` slot have no effect.
The tooltip is on by default (the label), because a label that only reaches screen readers leaves sighted users without a hint; upstream documents adding one as a best practice.

requests.reason: The inferred literal type 'tct-button' makes `class X extends TctButton { static tagName = 'x' }` a type error (TS2417); tct-icon-button casts today. Declare the field as a plain string so subclasses need no cast.
requests.diff:
-  static override readonly tagName = 'tct-button';
+  static override readonly tagName: string = 'tct-button';

core.icon-button.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] (name through the delegated ARIA of the inner button). Behaviour, focus ring and tooltip are tct-button's.
